name: DUMBBELL HIP THRUST
introduce: Sit with your feet flat on the floor. Rest your shoulders on a bench. Put a dumbbell on your hips. \n\nLift your hips until your knees are at 90 degrees. Hold for a second, then slowly lower them. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
